text:
oncall-bot: ALERT: Dedicated pool 'resv-prod-eu' has reached 100% GPU utilization and queue length > 8k. Autoscaler attempting scale, hitting provider quota. Paging oncall. Incident ID: INC-2427509

jess (oncall): I'm on it. Paging platform and runtime. GreenleafPay reporting timeouts.

maria (sre): Seeing a rapid queue growth on resv-prod-eu since 02:14 UTC. 95th latency spiking to 9s. Some tenants have >20 concurrent sessions.

sam (platform): Autoscaler logs show: 
```
E0425 02:15:12 scaler.go:421] scale request failed: quota_exceeded: cannot allocate additional GPUs in eu-central-1
E0425 02:15:17 scaler.go:446] retry limit reached, fallback to soft-throttle mode
```
Looks like provider quota + account-level limit. Manual scale blocked.

anya (eng-runtime): Runtime metrics indicate a small set of tenants (tenant_id: gf-9c4) are opening long-running sessions with high beam size. KV cache retention is preventing eviction. Suspect noisy neighbor.

jess (oncall): Is there an immediate mitigation we can apply to free capacity? Evict long idle sessions or reduce beam/concurrency per-tenant?

maria (sre): We can enforce per-tenant concurrency caps at the router layer. Proposing: set max_concurrency=4 for any tenant not in the enterprise_whitelist. But GreenleafPay is enterprise and on whitelist — we need to protect them first.

anya (eng-runtime): Quick action plan I can run now (requires 1-minute deploy to router config):
1) Apply emergency per-tenant token/call throttle to noisy tenant gf-9c4.
2) Trim KV cache TTL from 24h -> 30m for that tenant.
3) Force small-session eviction for sessions idle > 60s.

Commands:
```
# emergency router patch
rbctl route update resv-prod-eu --tenant-capacity gf-9c4=2 --apply
# update runtime KV TTL
rbctl runtime set-tenant-ttl gf-9c4 1800
```
I can run step 1+2 if platform approves.

sam (platform): Approve. But note autoscaler will still be unable to add nodes. We'll start a support ticket with infra provider for quota bump. In parallel, we can relocate some enterprise workloads to resv-standby-eu (smaller pool) for short term. That requires customer consent.

chad (support): Beth, FYI — GreenleafPay is seeing 503s. Should we open a bridge and send a hold message?

beth (acct mgmt): Yes, open a bridge. Drafting short note: "We're seeing capacity issues in eu region affecting some requests. We're applying mitigations now; we'll update in 15m. No data loss expected." Send to GreenleafPay.

ops-bot: ACTION: created bridge https://meet.redwood/inc-2427509 and opened PD incident INC-2427509. Organizer: jess (oncall).

jess (oncall): Running anya's router patch now. Will post outputs.

ops-bot: COMMAND OUTPUT:
```
rbctl route update resv-prod-eu --tenant-capacity gf-9c4=2 --apply
ok: route patch applied (txn 0x7f9a)
rbctl runtime set-tenant-ttl gf-9c4 1800
ok: ttl updated
```

maria (sre): After throttling, queue length dropped from 8200 -> 3100 over 2m. 95th latency down to 4.2s. Good immediate improvement.

anya (eng-runtime): Also evicted 34 idle sessions from gf-9c4 and cleared ~420GB of KV footprint. Runtime traced high memory churn from that tenant's streaming calls.

sam (platform): Provider responded: quota increase will take ~3-4h (manual approval). Not immediate. We'll need a mid-term plan. Options: 1) Move some non-critical enterprise tenants to the standby pool (resv-standby-eu). 2) Reclaim reserved capacity from underutilized teams (requires ops approval). 3) Enable graceful degradation: fall back to quantized smaller model for non-SLA traffic.

beth (acct mgmt): GreenleafPay requests priority — they have a peak in 30m. Can we bump them to priority routing to ensure their sessions land on preemptible overflow pool (lower latency but higher cost) or on standby?

maria (sre): We can temporarily reserve 2 GPUs from global overflow and pin to GreenleafPay. I can do that now: `resvctl allocate --pool overflow-global --gpus 2 --tenant gf-pay` Will do if approved.

jess (oncall): Approve allocation. Maria, go ahead. Also create a short public status update.

ops-bot: COMMAND OUTPUT:
```
resvctl allocate --pool overflow-global --gpus 2 --tenant gf-pay
ok: allocated 2 gpus -> overflow-global -> gf-pay (lease 30m)
```

chad (support): Sent customer message to GreenleafPay (bridge + slack) — they acknowledged and asked for ETA. Shared we expect partial relief within minutes and full mitigation in ~1h pending quota.

anya (eng-runtime): Rolling a soft-fallback to quantized gpt-compact for non-SLA routes. This reduces token throughput but halves GPU memory per session. Patching rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 10m.

maria (sre): Monitoring shows aggregate GPU utilization down to 86% after these mitigations. Queue trending down. Autoscaler still failing to scale due to quota but immediate customer impact reduced.

sam (platform): Filing provider support ticket: PS-678413. Manual quota bump requested. Also initiating internal change to avoid single-tenant KV retention blowups (engineering follow-up).

jess (oncall): Next steps / action items:
- (maria) Keep allocation to gf-pay for 30m and extend if required.
- (anya) Postmortem: investigate KV retention bug and create patch to auto-evict long-lived caches per-tenant (owner: eng-runtime).
- (sam) Track provider ticket and ETA. If >2h, schedule capacity re-org.
- (chad + beth) Communicate to GreenleafPay with updates every 15m.

ops-bot: NOTE: created task INC-2427509-T1: "Investigate noisy tenant eviction and KV retention" assigned to anya.

beth (acct mgmt): Customer asked for a short incident summary we can share later. Drafting post-incident note.

jess (oncall): Closing the immediate paging loop — queue recovering. Keeping bridge open for 1h. If any regression, re-page.

maria (sre): Last check at 02:31 UTC: queue 900, 95th latency 1.1s, GPU util 72%. Marking as mitigated.

chad (support): Customer confirms reduced errors. They thanked ops for quick action.

jess (oncall): Will own postmortem and timeline. Tentative sev: P2 due to customer impact but mitigated quickly. Assigning follow-ups.

anya (eng-runtime): I'll start a small patch to detect tenant KV growth > 200GB and auto-evict; will include unit tests.

sam (platform): Also proposing a change to autoscaler: if quota_exceeded for >2 attempts, fallback to aggressive per-tenant throttles automatically. Filing RFC.

ops-bot: INCIDENT INC-2427509 status: mitigated -> monitoring.

jess (oncall): Thanks team. Good run.
